outcome.label: Reported security fatalities
outcome.coverage_note: **Landed 2026-10-17; re-landed 26.1 on 2026-10-30 (C-82).** 8,255 Nigeria events 1990-09 to 2025-12, state-attributed (`adm_1`), so the state panel carries a 37-unit outcome and the national spine carries a monthly one from 1999-01. The World Bank series is unusable (homicides: 3 observations, C-10) and ACLED remains licence-blocked (C-13), but neither was needed: the UCDP API wants a token (C-14) while the UCDP **bulk archive** does not, and UCDP GED is CC-BY 4.0. 80 % of state-months are zero and every state series is flagged by the Stage 3 spike gate, which is what a monthly conflict count does — see `analysis/specs/quality.yml` `document_sources.ucdp.spike_note`.

design.name: Synthetic control (cross-country)
design.unit: country-year (Nigeria treated; West African neighbours + oil exporters)
design.estimand: treatment gap: Nigeria outcome minus synthetic Nigeria
design.estimator: Synth / coresynth / scpi, donor pool screened by pre-treatment fit
design_controls: Donor weights chosen to reproduce Nigeria's pre-treatment outcome path and predictors
In-space placebo across every donor; in-time placebo; leave-one-donor-out sweep
Pool composition treated as a robustness axis, not a fixed choice

nodes.label: Common factors (global oil / commodity cycle)
nodes.source: Derived from the donor-panel paths and the FRED Brent crude cycle (node 'oil')

nodes.label: Donor-pool outcome paths (synthetic weights)
nodes.source: Donor panel: 99 candidate countries x 5 predictors (World Bank), widened 2026-10-18

nodes.label: Nigeria-specific shock coinciding with treatment
nodes.source: Unobserved: assumed absent by the synthetic-control assumption

identifying_assumption: The synthetic control reproduces Nigeria's outcome path absent treatment: donor-weighted common factors (above all the global oil and commodity cycle) stand in for Nigeria's counterfactual, and no Nigeria-specific shock coincides with the treatment (the unobserved node is absent).
cannot_rule_out: Idiosyncratic Nigeria-only shocks inside the treatment window (Niger Delta militancy, insurgency).
Five treated tenures is a small treated set — the donor pool cannot always buy a credible counterfactual.
Sparse pre-treatment fit weakens the comparison, and the card must say so rather than ship the gap.
Contemporaneous global shocks affect donors differently than Nigeria even when the oil channel is shared.
